newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weak on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weak on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but weakened against the pound sterling on Friday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.7315 to the dollar from 20.7795 on Thursday, and at 34.19 to the pound from 34.0505.
Forex dealers said there was no big activity on the inter- bank forex market as importers' demand was subdued.
